parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, the two methods belong to distinct test classes (`AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.stopTransitionsToIdle` at line 71 and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks` at line 164) that are intentionally testing different behavioral contracts — state transition vs. idempotency — which naturally produces structurally similar but semantically distinct test bodies. Collapsing them would obscure test intent and violate the principle that each test should clearly express a single, named behavior.
